card.name: The word part after an adjective
card.fires_on: The word "part" (or "parts", "aspect") right after an adjective such as hardest, best, favorite, fun or vital, where "of ..." comes next.

modes.label: Part after a describing word
modes.description: "part" follows a superlative or evaluative adjective and leads into "of" plus the whole.
modes.example: “My favorite<< part>> of the day was the mock trial.

modes.label: Similar noun aspect
modes.description: "aspect" or "parts" used the same way, meaning a portion of something larger.
modes.example: The study was only focusing on one<< aspect>> of climate change

card.writes: It seems to push toward word starts and counting or position words, with no clear link to the next word.
card.plain: It fires on the word "part" in phrases like "the best part of" or "an important part of".
